role: Detects when the same (operation, operand_ids) computation produces conflicting result ValueNodes in the PKG and records contradictions.
detail: ContradictionDetector is a Layer 3 service that compares new computation results against existing COMPUTES_TO edges; when a conflict is found (same inputs, different outputs), it creates a new conflict edge, halves confidence on both edges, increments error_count, cross-links them with has_conflict/conflicting_edge_id metadata, and emits ContradictionDetectedEvent. ContradictionResult is the frozen dataclass return type holding contradiction_found and conflicting_edge_ids. The detector never resolves which result is correct—that is guardian/Layer 4 responsibility. It can operate without an event bus, accumulating pending_events for manual drain. Initial confidence for new conflict edges is 0.15 (BASE_PROCEDURAL).
gotchas: Conflict edge ID is constructed from first operand only (operand_id_strs[0]), not all operands, which could lose information if operation order matters. Existing edge properties are mutated in-place before save. No validation that existing_edge is actually a COMPUTES_TO edge—caller responsibility. If get_node fails for existing result lookup, existing_result_value remains None silently.
